# Azure, Entra ID and Defender adapter fixtures

**Every file here is SYNTHETIC.** None was recorded against a real tenant:
they are hand-made from the documented response shapes of the APIs below,
generated by a script, with synthetic names (`*.contoso.example.test`,
`kv-contoso-prod`), all-pattern GUIDs and subscription
`11111111-2222-3333-4444-555555555555`. The certificates are throw-away
certificates issued by "Meiscope Synthetic Test CA"; their keys were deleted
when they were made and never entered the repository. No tokens, client
secrets, secret values or private keys appear in any fixture. Access tokens
and the Key Vault PEM secret value are produced by the tests at run time, so
that no key armour or token shape is ever stored here.

| Directory | API (documented shape) | Must be re-recorded against a test tenant |
|---|---|---|
| `keyvault/` | Key Vault REST 7.4: `GET /certificates`, `GET /certificates/{name}`, `GET /secrets` | yes: list paging (`nextLink`, `$skiptoken`), `cer`, `x5t`, `policy.issuer`, `lifetime_actions`, `managed` on certificate-backed secrets |
| `appservice/` | ARM `Microsoft.Web/certificates` and `Microsoft.Web/sites` list by subscription, api-version 2023-12-01 | yes: whether list answers include `cerBlob`, `canonicalName` on managed certificates, `hostNameSslStates` thumbprint case |
| `appgateway/` | ARM `Microsoft.Network/applicationGateways` list by subscription, api-version 2024-05-01 | yes: `publicCertData` (PKCS#7) on uploaded and Key Vault-linked certificates, listener `hostNames` |
| `entra/` | Microsoft Graph v1.0 `GET /applications/delta` with `$select` | yes: `customKeyIdentifier` encoding for portal-uploaded and Graph-uploaded certificates, delta paging and `410 Gone` on an expired token |
| `defender/` | Microsoft Graph v1.0 `POST /security/runHuntingQuery` over `DeviceTvmCertificateInfo` | yes: column names and types (`KeySize`, `Path` forms for registry and file stores), `DeviceInfo` join |

`pem-secret-certificate.b64` is the base64 DER of the synthetic certificate
the Key Vault PEM-secret test wraps in PEM at run time.
